Guidance & outlook: In FY26, our consolidated revenue grew 4.7% to ₹ 2,121 crore.
Looking ahead, the M&E sector is expected to cross ₹ 3.1 trillion by 2028, growing at a CAGR of over 7%.
Digital advertising spends by SMEs is expected to grow to ₹ 563 billion by 2028.
Growth & demand: Excluding the first quarter, which was impacted by a high base of election-linked advertising, revenue grew 7%, an achievement given the subdued macro conditions and the multiple headwinds faced by the industry.
Total advertising grew 13.5% to reach ₹ 1.5 trillion, with digital media accounting for 63% of total advertising revenues.
Digital media was the sole driver of advertising growth, contributing to over 100% of growth in 2025, reaching ₹ 947 billion.
Margins & costs: The Company maintained tight cost discipline with expenses growing by only 2.5% YoY.
